author: Home Repair Tutor
description: I’m installing the top of this niche but the tile is slightly too thick. So I used my grinder to shave off some if the porcelain. This helps complete the miter and create a tight fit. My full online course shares how to frame, waterproof and tile this niche - you can check it out at https://homerepairtutor.com/tile-shower-niche-with-miters-12x12/
